name: Klingenthal (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over light blue, charged at the centre with the city arms of Klingenthal (a yellow lyre on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Klingenthal; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Klingenthal arms — yellow lyre on blue
